id: title:gustavohstrassburger:disable realtime cohort calculation for p80 p100 tiers

review.posthog_relevance: Reduction of resource consumption and prevention of potential overload in cohort calculation workflows, specifically retaining P0-P80 percentile schedules while removing P80-P100 schedules.
review.reason: The observed change removes scheduled jobs for P80-P100 percentile tiers while retaining P0-P80, which could reduce resource consumption and prevent potential overload or stale data for those tiers. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and the specific implementation of the schedule removal are not fully demonstrated in the provided hunk; the benefit relies on the assumption that P80-P100 schedules are indeed expensive and slow, which is not independently verified by the code shown. No tests or rollback checks are visible in this hunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No binary/generated-only hunks. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation change: P0-P80 percentile schedules are retained; P80-P100 schedules are deleted.
observations.posthog_connection: This change removes scheduled jobs for the p80-p100 percentile tiers, preventing those expensive, slow-to-compute cohort calculations from firing. This could reduce resource consumption and prevent potential overload or stale data for those tiers, while retaining the faster p0-p80 tiers.
